verses.original: בְּיָמָ֣יו עָלָ֔ה נְבֻכַדְנֶאצַּ֖ר מֶ֣לֶךְ בָּבֶ֑ל וַיְהִי־ ל֨וֹ יְהוֹיָקִ֥ים עֶ֙בֶד֙ שָׁלֹ֣שׁ שָׁנִ֔ים וַיָּ֖שָׁב וַיִּמְרָד־ בּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: bə·yā·māw ‘ā·lāh nə·ḇu·ḵaḏ·neṣ·ṣar me·leḵ bā·ḇel way·hî- lōw yə·hō·w·yā·qîm ‘e·ḇeḏ šā·lōš šā·nîm way·yā·šāḇ way·yim·rāḏ- bōw
verses.literal: During Jehoiakim’s reign Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon invaded So Jehoiakim became his vassal for three years until he turned and rebelled against Nebuchadnezzar
verses.literalPt: NOS seus dias subiu Nabucodonosor, rei de Babilônia, e Jeoiaquim ficou três anos seu servo; depois se virou, e se rebelou contra ele.

verses.original: וַיְשַׁלַּ֣ח יְהוָ֣ה׀ בּ֡וֹ אֶת־ גְּדוּדֵ֣י כַשְׂדִּים֩ וְאֶת־ גְּדוּדֵ֨י אֲרָ֜ם וְאֵ֣ת׀ גְּדוּדֵ֣י מוֹאָ֗ב וְאֵת֙ גְּדוּדֵ֣י בְנֵֽי־ עַמּ֔וֹן וַיְשַׁלְּחֵ֥ם בִּֽיהוּדָ֖ה לְהַֽאֲבִיד֑וֹ כִּדְבַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבֶּ֔ר בְּיַ֖ד עֲבָדָ֥יו הַנְּבִיאִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·šal·laḥ Yah·weh bōw ’eṯ- gə·ḏū·ḏê ḵaś·dîm wə·’eṯ- gə·ḏū·ḏê ’ă·rām wə·’êṯ gə·ḏū·ḏê mō·w·’āḇ wə·’êṯ gə·ḏū·ḏê ḇə·nê- ‘am·mō·wn way·šal·lə·ḥêm bî·hū·ḏāh lə·ha·’ă·ḇî·ḏōw kiḏ·ḇar Yah·weh ’ă·šer dib·ber bə·yaḏ ‘ă·ḇā·ḏāw han·nə·ḇî·’îm
verses.literal: And the LORD sent Chaldean - Aramean - Moabite - and Ammonite . . . raiders against Jehoiakim in order to destroy Judah according to the word that the LORD had spoken through His servants the prophets
verses.literalPt: E o SENHOR enviou contra ele as tropas dos caldeus, as tropas dos sírios, as tropas dos moabitas e as tropas dos filhos de Amom; e as enviou contra Judá, para o destruir, conforme a palavra do SENHOR, que falara pelo ministério de seus servos, os profetas.

verses.original: אַ֣ךְ׀ עַל־ פִּ֣י יְהוָ֗ה הָֽיְתָה֙ בִּֽיהוּדָ֔ה לְהָסִ֖יר מֵעַ֣ל פָּנָ֑יו בְּחַטֹּ֣את מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה כְּכֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָֽׂה׃
verses.transliteration: ’aḵ ‘al- pî Yah·weh hā·yə·ṯāh bî·hū·ḏāh lə·hā·sîr mê·‘al pā·nāw bə·ḥaṭ·ṭōṯ mə·naš·šeh kə·ḵōl ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh
verses.literal: Surely this happened to Judah at the LORD’s command to remove them from His presence because of the sins of Manasseh and all that he had done
verses.literalPt: E, na verdade, conforme o mandado do SENHOR, assim sucedeu a Judá, para o afastar da sua presença por causa dos pecados de Manassés, conforme tudo quanto fizera.

verses.original: וְגַ֤ם דַּֽם־ הַנָּקִי֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר שָׁפָ֔ךְ וַיְמַלֵּ֥א אֶת־ יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם דָּ֣ם נָקִ֑י וְלֹֽא־ אָבָ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה לִסְלֹֽחַ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḡam dam- han·nā·qî ’ă·šer šā·p̄āḵ way·mal·lê ’eṯ- yə·rū·šā·lim dām nā·qî wə·lō- ’ā·ḇāh Yah·weh lis·lō·aḥ
verses.literal: and also for the innocent blood he had shed For he had filled Jerusalem with innocent blood and the LORD was unwilling to forgive
verses.literalPt: Como também por causa do sangue inocente que derramou; pois encheu a Jerusalém de sangue inocente; e por isso o SENHOR não quis perdoar.

verses.original: וְיֶ֛תֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י יְהוֹיָקִ֖ים וְכָל־ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֑ה הֲלֹא־ הֵ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל־ סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַיָּמִ֖ים לְמַלְכֵ֥י יְהוּדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ye·ṯer diḇ·rê yə·hō·w·yā·qîm wə·ḵāl ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh hă·lō- hêm kə·ṯū·ḇîm ‘al- sê·p̄er diḇ·rê hay·yā·mîm lə·mal·ḵê yə·hū·ḏāh
verses.literal: As for the rest of the acts of Jehoiakim along with all his accomplishments . . . are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles . . . of the Kings of Judah
verses.literalPt: Ora, o mais dos atos de Jeoiaquim, e tudo quanto fez, porventura não está escrito no livro das crônicas dos reis de Judá?

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁכַּ֥ב יְהוֹיָקִ֖ים עִם־ אֲבֹתָ֑יו וַיִּמְלֹ֛ךְ יְהוֹיָכִ֥ין בְּנ֖וֹ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·kaḇ yə·hō·w·yā·qîm ‘im- ’ă·ḇō·ṯāw way·yim·lōḵ yə·hō·w·yā·ḵîn bə·nōw taḥ·tāw
verses.literal: And Jehoiakim rested with his fathers and his son Jehoiachin reigned in his place
verses.literalPt: E Jeoiaquim dormiu com seus pais; e Joaquim, seu filho, reinou em seu lugar.

verses.original: וְלֹֽא־ הֹסִ֥יף עוֹד֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ מִצְרַ֔יִם לָצֵ֖את מֵֽאַרְצ֑וֹ כִּֽי־ לָקַ֞ח מֶ֣לֶךְ בָּבֶ֗ל מִנַּ֤חַל מִצְרַ֙יִם֙ עַד־ נְהַר־ פְּרָ֔ת כֹּ֛ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָיְתָ֖ה לְמֶ֥לֶךְ מִצְרָֽיִם׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·lō- hō·sîp̄ ‘ō·wḏ me·leḵ miṣ·ra·yim lā·ṣêṯ mê·’ar·ṣōw kî- lā·qaḥ me·leḵ bā·ḇel min·na·ḥal miṣ·ra·yim ‘aḏ- nə·har- pə·rāṯ kōl ’ă·šer hā·yə·ṯāh lə·me·leḵ miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: Now the king of Egypt did not march out of his land again . . . because the king of Babylon had taken all his territory . . . . . . from the Brook of Egypt to the Euphrates River
verses.literalPt: E o rei do Egito nunca mais saiu da sua terra; porque o rei de Babilônia tomou tudo quanto era do rei do Egito, desde o rio do Egito até ao rio Eufrates.

verses.original: בֶּן־ שְׁמֹנֶ֨ה עֶשְׂרֵ֤ה שָׁנָה֙ יְהוֹיָכִ֣ין בְּמָלְכ֔וֹ וּשְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה חֳדָשִׁ֔ים מָלַ֖ךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְשֵׁ֣ם אִמּ֔וֹ נְחֻשְׁתָּ֥א בַת־ אֶלְנָתָ֖ן מִירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ben- šə·mō·neh ‘eś·rêh šā·nāh yə·hō·w·yā·ḵîn bə·mā·lə·ḵōw ū·šə·lō·šāh ḥo·ḏā·šîm mā·laḵ bî·rū·šā·lim wə·šêm ’im·mōw nə·ḥuš·tā ḇaṯ- ’el·nā·ṯān mî·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: Jehoiachin was eighteen . . . years old . . . when he became king and he reigned in Jerusalem three months His mother’s name was Nehushta daughter of Elnathan she was from Jerusalem
verses.literalPt: Tinha Joaquim dezoito anos de idade quando começou a reinar, e reinou três meses em Jerusalém; e era o nome de sua mãe, Neusta, filha de Elnatã, de Jerusalém.

verses.original: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ הָרַ֖ע בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כְּכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־ עָשָׂ֖ה אָבִֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś hā·ra‘ bə·‘ê·nê Yah·weh kə·ḵōl ’ă·šer- ‘ā·śāh ’ā·ḇîw
verses.literal: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD just as his father had done
verses.literalPt: E fez o que era mau aos olhos do SENHOR, conforme tudo quanto fizera seu pai.

verses.original: בָּעֵ֣ת הַהִ֔יא עָלָה עַבְדֵ֛י נְבֻכַדְנֶאצַּ֥ר מֶֽלֶךְ־ בָּבֶ֖ל יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וַתָּבֹ֥א הָעִ֖יר בַּמָּצֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: bā·‘êṯ ha·hî ʿå̄·lå̄h ‘aḇ·ḏê nə·ḇu·ḵaḏ·neṣ·ṣar me·leḵ- bā·ḇel yə·rū·šā·lim wat·tā·ḇō hā·‘îr bam·mā·ṣō·wr
verses.literal: At that time the servants of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon marched up to Jerusalem and the city came under siege
verses.literalPt: Naquele tempo subiram os servos de Nabucodonosor, rei de Babilônia, a Jerusalém; e a cidade foi cercada.

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֛א נְבוּכַדְנֶאצַּ֥ר מֶֽלֶךְ־ בָּבֶ֖ל עַל־ הָעִ֑יר וַעֲבָדָ֖יו צָרִ֥ים עָלֶֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō nə·ḇū·ḵaḏ·neṣ·ṣar me·leḵ- bā·ḇel ‘al- hā·‘îr wa·‘ă·ḇā·ḏāw ṣā·rîm ‘ā·le·hā
verses.literal: And Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came to the city while his servants were besieging it . . .
verses.literalPt: Também veio Nabucodonosor, rei de Babilônia, contra a cidade, quando já os seus servos a estavam sitiando.

verses.original: וַיֵּצֵ֞א יְהוֹיָכִ֤ין מֶֽלֶךְ־ יְהוּדָה֙ עַל־ מֶ֣לֶךְ בָּבֶ֔ל ה֣וּא וְאִמּ֔וֹ וַעֲבָדָ֖יו וְשָׂרָ֣יו וְסָֽרִיסָ֑יו וַיִּקַּ֤ח אֹתוֹ֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ בָּבֶ֔ל בִּשְׁנַ֥ת שְׁמֹנֶ֖ה לְמָלְכֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·ṣê yə·hō·w·yā·ḵîn me·leḵ- yə·hū·ḏāh ‘al- me·leḵ bā·ḇel hū wə·’im·mōw wa·‘ă·ḇā·ḏāw wə·śā·rāw wə·sā·rî·sāw way·yiq·qaḥ ’ō·ṯōw me·leḵ bā·ḇel biš·naṯ šə·mō·neh lə·mā·lə·ḵōw
verses.literal: Jehoiachin king of Judah his mother his servants his commanders and his officials all surrendered to the king of Babylon . . . So in the eighth year of his reign the king of Babylon took him captive
verses.literalPt: Então saiu Joaquim, rei de Judá, ao rei de Babilônia, ele, sua mãe, seus servos, seus príncipes e seus oficiais; e o rei de Babilônia o tomou preso, no ano oitavo do seu reinado.

verses.original: וַיּוֹצֵ֣א מִשָּׁ֗ם אֶת־ כָּל־ אוֹצְרוֹת֙ בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה וְאֽוֹצְר֖וֹת בֵּ֣ית הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וַיְקַצֵּ֞ץ אֶת־ כָּל־ כְּלֵ֣י הַזָּהָ֗ב אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשָׂ֜ה שְׁלֹמֹ֤ה מֶֽלֶךְ־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ בְּהֵיכַ֣ל יְהוָ֔ה כַּֽאֲשֶׁ֖ר דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·w·ṣê miš·šām ’eṯ- kāl- ’ō·wṣ·rō·wṯ bêṯ Yah·weh wə·’ō·wṣ·rō·wṯ bêṯ ham·me·leḵ way·qaṣ·ṣêṣ ’eṯ- kāl- kə·lê haz·zā·hāḇ ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh šə·lō·mōh me·leḵ- yiś·rā·’êl bə·hê·ḵal Yah·weh ka·’ă·šer dib·ber Yah·weh
verses.literal: As the LORD had declared Nebuchadnezzar also carried off . . . all the treasures from the house of the LORD and the royal palace and he cut into pieces all the gold articles that Solomon king of Israel had made in the temple of the LORD
verses.literalPt: E tirou dali todos os tesouros da casa do SENHOR e os tesouros da casa do rei; e partiu todos os vasos de ouro, que fizera Salomão, rei de Israel, no templo do SENHOR, como o SENHOR tinha falado.

verses.original: וְהִגְלָ֣ה אֶת־ כָּל־ יְ֠רוּשָׁלִַם וְֽאֶת־ כָּל־ הַשָּׂרִ֞ים וְאֵ֣ת׀ כָּל־ גִּבּוֹרֵ֣י הַחַ֗יִל עֲשָׂרָה אֲלָפִים֙ גּוֹלֶ֔ה וְכָל־ הֶחָרָ֖שׁ וְהַמַּסְגֵּ֑ר לֹ֣א נִשְׁאַ֔ר זוּלַ֖ת דַּלַּ֥ת עַם־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hiḡ·lāh ’eṯ- kāl- yə·rū·šā·lim wə·’eṯ- kāl- haś·śā·rîm wə·’êṯ kāl- gib·bō·w·rê ha·ḥa·yil ʿă·śå̄·rå̄h ’ă·lā·p̄îm gō·w·leh wə·ḵāl he·ḥā·rāš wə·ham·mas·gêr lō niš·’ar zū·laṯ dal·laṯ ‘am- hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: He carried into exile all Jerusalem all the commanders and mighty men of valor all the craftsmen and metalsmiths ten thousand captives in all Only the poorest people of the land remained
verses.literalPt: E transportou a toda a Jerusalém como também a todos os príncipes, e a todos os homens valorosos, dez mil presos, e a todos os artífices e ferreiros; ninguém ficou senão o povo pobre da terra.

verses.original: וַיֶּ֥גֶל אֶת־ יְהוֹיָכִ֖ין בָּבֶ֑לָה וְאֶת־ אֵ֣ם הַ֠מֶּלֶךְ וְאֶת־ נְשֵׁ֨י הַמֶּ֜לֶךְ וְאֶת־ סָרִיסָ֗יו וְאֵת֙ אֱוִלֵי הָאָ֔רֶץ הוֹלִ֛יךְ גּוֹלָ֥ה מִירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם בָּבֶֽלָה׃
verses.transliteration: way·ye·ḡel ’eṯ- yə·hō·w·yā·ḵîn bā·ḇe·lāh wə·’eṯ- ’êm ham·me·leḵ wə·’eṯ- nə·šê ham·me·leḵ wə·’eṯ- sā·rî·sāw wə·’êṯ ʾɛ̆·wi·lē hā·’ā·reṣ hō·w·lîḵ gō·w·lāh mî·rū·šā·lim bā·ḇe·lāh
verses.literal: Nebuchadnezzar carried away Jehoiachin to Babylon as well as the king’s mother his wives his officials and the leading men . . . of the land He took them into exile from Jerusalem to Babylon
verses.literalPt: Assim transportou Joaquim à Babilônia; como também a mãe do rei, as mulheres do rei, os seus oficiais e os poderosos da terra levou presos de Jerusalém à Babilônia.

verses.original: וְאֵת֩ כָּל־ אַנְשֵׁ֨י הַחַ֜יִל שִׁבְעַ֣ת אֲלָפִ֗ים וְהֶחָרָ֤שׁ וְהַמַּסְגֵּר֙ אֶ֔לֶף הַכֹּ֕ל גִּבּוֹרִ֖ים עֹשֵׂ֣י מִלְחָמָ֑ה וַיְבִיאֵ֧ם מֶֽלֶךְ־ בָּבֶ֛ל גּוֹלָ֖ה בָּבֶֽלָה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êṯ kāl- ’an·šê ha·ḥa·yil šiḇ·‘aṯ ’ă·lā·p̄îm wə·he·ḥā·rāš wə·ham·mas·gêr ’e·lep̄ hak·kōl gib·bō·w·rîm ‘ō·śê mil·ḥā·māh way·ḇî·’êm me·leḵ- bā·ḇel gō·w·lāh bā·ḇe·lāh
verses.literal: The king of Babylon also brought into exile to Babylon all seven thousand men of valor and a thousand craftsmen and metalsmiths all strong and fit for battle
verses.literalPt: E todos os homens valentes, até sete mil, e artífices e ferreiros até mil, e todos os homens destros na guerra, a estes o rei de Babilônia levou presos para Babilônia.

verses.original: וַיַּמְלֵ֧ךְ מֶֽלֶךְ־ בָּבֶ֛ל אֶת־ מַתַּנְיָ֥ה דֹד֖וֹ תַּחְתָּ֑יו וַיַּסֵּ֥ב אֶת־ שְׁמ֖וֹ צִדְקִיָּֽהוּ׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yam·lêḵ me·leḵ- bā·ḇel ’eṯ- mat·tan·yāh ḏō·ḏōw taḥ·tāw way·yas·sêḇ ’eṯ- šə·mōw ṣiḏ·qî·yā·hū
verses.literal: Then the king of Babylon made Mattaniah Jehoiachin’s uncle king in his place and changed his name to Zedekiah
verses.literalPt: E o rei de Babilônia estabeleceu a Matanias, seu tio, rei em seu lugar; e lhe mudou o nome para Zedequias.

verses.original: בֶּן־ עֶשְׂרִ֨ים וְאַחַ֤ת שָׁנָה֙ צִדְקִיָּ֣הוּ בְמָלְכ֔וֹ וְאַחַ֤ת עֶשְׂרֵה֙ שָׁנָ֔ה מָלַ֖ךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְשֵׁ֣ם אִמּ֔וֹ חֲמִיטַל בַּֽת־ יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ מִלִּבְנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ben- ‘eś·rîm wə·’a·ḥaṯ šā·nāh ṣiḏ·qî·yā·hū ḇə·mā·lə·ḵōw wə·’a·ḥaṯ ‘eś·rêh šā·nāh mā·laḵ bî·rū·šā·lim wə·šêm ’im·mōw ḥă·mī·ṭal baṯ- yir·mə·yā·hū mil·liḇ·nāh
verses.literal: Zedekiah was twenty-one . . . years old . . . when he became king and he reigned in Jerusalem eleven . . . years His mother’s name was Hamutal daughter of Jeremiah she was from Libnah
verses.literalPt: Tinha Zedequias vinte e um anos de idade quando começou a reinar, e reinou onze anos em Jerusalém; e era o nome de sua mãe Hamutal, filha de Jeremias, de Libna.

verses.original: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ הָרַ֖ע בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כְּכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־ עָשָׂ֖ה יְהוֹיָקִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś hā·ra‘ bə·‘ê·nê Yah·weh kə·ḵōl ’ă·šer- ‘ā·śāh yə·hō·w·yā·qîm
verses.literal: And Zedekiah did evil in the sight of the LORD just as Jehoiakim had done
verses.literalPt: E fez o que era mau aos olhos do SENHOR, conforme tudo quanto fizera Jeoiaquim.

verses.original: כִּ֣י׀ עַל־ אַ֣ף יְהוָ֗ה הָיְתָ֤ה בִירוּשָׁלִַ֙ם֙ וּבִ֣יהוּדָ֔ה עַד־ הִשְׁלִכ֥וֹ אֹתָ֖ם מֵעַ֣ל פָּנָ֑יו וַיִּמְרֹ֥ד צִדְקִיָּ֖הוּ בְּמֶ֥לֶךְ בָּבֶֽל׃ס
verses.transliteration: kî ‘al- ’ap̄ Yah·weh hā·yə·ṯāh ḇî·rū·šā·lim ū·ḇî·hū·ḏāh ‘aḏ- hiš·li·ḵōw ’ō·ṯām mê·‘al pā·nāw way·yim·rōḏ ṣiḏ·qî·yā·hū bə·me·leḵ bā·ḇel
verses.literal: For because of the anger of the LORD all this happened in Jerusalem and Judah until He finally banished them from His presence And Zedekiah also rebelled against the king of Babylon
verses.literalPt: Porque assim sucedeu por causa da ira do SENHOR contra Jerusalém, e contra Judá, até os rejeitar de diante da sua presença; e Zedequias se rebelou contra o rei de Babilônia.
